decisions.reason: Requiring operation without a battery does not alter the electrical protections required when a battery is connected.
Batteryless USB operation does not change the NTC monitoring behavior applicable when a battery is present.
The existing routing requirement already covers the USB-C VBUS path and the battery path independently; batteryless operation introduces no necessary routing-state change.
The source decision concerns supplying the system without a battery and does not change how battery-charge status is exposed.
Batteryless input support does not change the boost converter's GPIO control, default state, output rating, or assigned loads.
The DCDC1 voltage-regulation requirement remains unchanged regardless of whether the AXP2101 input is supplied by USB or a battery.
Batteryless system operation does not alter the requested VBACKUP access or VRTC handling.
The AXP2101 exposed-pad thermal requirement remains applicable and unchanged under USB-only operation.
The source decision does not change the requested PWROK test-pad access or its debug purpose.
Allowing operation without a battery does not remove or modify the connector required for configurations where a battery is installed.
The source decision does not specify any change to the panel button, connector, PWRON signal, or control behavior.
The ESP32 supply-decoupling requirement remains unchanged when the system is powered from USB without a battery.
